summary: Isabella Bank Corp filed an 8-K announcing it received all required regulatory approvals to complete its merger with Grand River Commerce, Inc., whose shareholders approved the deal on September 18, 2026. The expected closing date is November 2, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. No price, exchange ratio, premium, or advisor was disclosed in the excerpt. The filing reflects a bank holding company acquisition progressing toward completion, with all regulatory gating items cleared and shareholder approval secured. The remaining risk is limited to customary closing conditions, making this a late-stage, low-spread merger-arb situation.
